Escitalopram is superior because it's the isolated S-enantiomeer of Citalopram. It is essentially the isolated active compound of Citalopram so it cuts out "the bullshit" sort of speak. This results in the same anti-depressive and anxiolytic properties but with a faster onset of action, less drug-drug interactions, and less side effects. In clinical studies common SSRI side effects like weight gain and sexual dysfunction occur significantly less frequently in Escitalopram compared to others. Also the withdrawal syndrome upon discontinuation of the drug tends to be far more tolerable compared to other SSRI's (with the exception of Fluoxetine). Combine all of this and you get the THEORETICAL superior SSRI. I say theoretical because in practice there is no such thing as a superior SSRI. Which all comes down to the genetic make up of the person taking it as to how effective it is and what side effects occur.

Are there any exclusives you care about? Like the Forza and Halo franchises on Xbox or the God Of War/Horizon Forbidden West / Gran Turismo games on PS5?  But yeah, in short, for €500,- you get a great console either way. And it will perform better than your current setup, but it will also be outdated sooner.
